question: Walking at (4)/(7) of his normal speed from his home, Shahid is 12 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed = 4/7 ⇒ time becomes 7/4

Extra time = (7/4 − 1) = 3/4 of usual time

3/4 of usual time = 12

Usual time = 12 × 4/3 = 16

**∴ Answer = 16 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed = 4/7 of normal

Delay = 12 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New speed = (4/7) of normal ⇒ new time = (7/4)T

⇒ Increase in time = (7/4)T − T

⇒ = (3/4)T

⇒ Given increase = 12

⇒ (3/4)T = 12

⇒ T = 12 × 4/3

⇒ T = 16 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 16 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inverse Relation

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

Key Trick

If speed = a/b, then time = b/a

Extra Time

Find difference between new and original time
